p: Green Lanes through Harringay is one of London's best food streets, famous for its Turkish and Kurdish restaurants, charcoal ocakbasi grills, bakeries and late-opening grocers. Come hungry and you'll be very well looked after.

The Harringay Ladder, the grid of terraced streets running off Green Lanes, gives the area its name, and Finsbury Park is a short walk south for a breather. Alexandra Palace sits up on the hill to the north, with sweeping views over London, and is easy to reach by bus. Admiral itself is an adults-only gaming centre, so it's 18+ and not for the kids. Parking can be tight, so the bus or the train to Harringay Green Lanes is often easier.
